value.rationale: The resonance gives a natural exact periodic reference for damped twist maps. Exact stability and nonlinear branch response quantify when a resonant period-two sink is replaced by a period-four sink, over every fixed damping ratio, including the amplitude and decay-rate slopes. This is not a direct restatement of general flip theory and provides a concrete analytic benchmark.
